intro: You can leave whenever you like. I am not your quest marker.
The little one keeps collecting things. Nobody knows why.
Those relays predate the paths. Maybe try building a signal key.
He had his own plans long before you arrived.

logs.title: An unrequested arrival
logs.text: The screens are windows. None of them are the whole world.

logs.title: A little arrangement
logs.text: The character takes what interests him, not what the player expects.

logs.title: Device fragment
logs.text: A machine humming in a place with no power line.

logs.title: No answer
logs.text: He does not explain his mission. There is still no answer.
